name: Mountain Wildfire Front Monitoring
mission_theme: Ridge fire moving east: thermal front mapping, spot-fire search and a long relay to the valley command post.

zones.notes: fire camp and water point, 4 sectors

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-NORTH (90% target, 3 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-NORTH completely. Fly parallel tracks at 90 m AGL with 25 % side overlap and keep every UAV 20 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 90 %. Recover to LZ-RIDGE when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-NORTH with 3 UAVs at 90 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 90 % of the block with 25 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 20 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes

checkpoints.name: Team launch
checkpoints.metric: elapsed time from task start to last UAV inside BLOCK-NORTH

checkpoints.name: Track discipline
checkpoints.metric: cross-track error per strip and side overlap between adjacent strips

checkpoints.name: Coverage target
checkpoints.metric: union coverage of BLOCK-NORTH at the recorded altitude

checkpoints.name: Airspace integrity
checkpoints.metric: time outside geofence and inside no-fly zones
checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.metric: landing separation and hard-landing flag
checkpoints.target: all UAVs on ground at LZ-RIDGE, separation >= 10 m, no hard landing

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Search and rescue sweep of AREA-SPOT (sweep 120 m, beacon in C3)
tasks.brief: A distress beacon is active somewhere in AREA-SPOT. Sweep the area cooperatively at 100 m with 120 m spacing between tracks so that at least 95% of the area is observed once. When a UAV detects the signal, localise it to within 25 m, mark the spot (hover >= 10 s and transmit the position) and hand the position to the rescue element. Do not leave uncovered strips when the first detection happens.
tasks.objective: Sweep AREA-SPOT with 4 UAVs at 100 m using a 120 m sweep width until the distress beacon is detected, localised to within 25 m and marked.

actions: report the beacon to the team

constraints: minimum separation 20 m
no flight inside the marked danger radius before the rescue element arrives
failure_conditions: beacon not detected within the window
abandoning the sweep to chase a false signal

checkpoints.metric: area observed at least once before task end

checkpoints.name: Detection
checkpoints.metric: beacon detection event
checkpoints.target: detected before the task window closes

checkpoints.name: Localisation
checkpoints.metric: error of the transmitted beacon position

checkpoints.target: hover >= 10 s and handover message sent

checkpoints.name: No uncovered strip

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Point inspection of POI-FIRE-FRONT (25 m standoff, 6 images)
tasks.brief: Inspect POI-FIRE-FRONT. Hold a standoff of 25 m (tolerance 3 m) at 45 m AGL, aim the gimbal 30 deg down and take at least 6 images per face. Hover at least 12 s at each capture point so the image is stable. Do not enter the 10 m keep-out radius around POI-FIRE-FRONT and keep 30 m from your teammate.

capture 6 images per angle with 30 deg pitch
check image count and pitch per angle
re-capture any angle short of 6 images

constraints: hover only at declared capture points
no flight below 45 m in the inspection ring
failure_conditions: fewer than one complete angle set at task end
loss of link during capture with no recovery

tasks.title: Relay chain between GS-CMD and GS-OUTPOST (3 hops, 12 min)
tasks.brief: Link GS-CMD and GS-OUTPOST, which are 5900 m apart and cannot see each other. Fly a relay chain of 3 UAVs at 160 m AGL, keep the end-to-end link above -90 dBm for 12 min, and rebuild the chain within 45 s if a relay drops. No UAV may hover closer than 120 m to another.
tasks.objective: Position 3 UAVs so that GS-CMD and GS-OUTPOST keep an end-to-end link with RSSI >= -90 dBm for 12 min, and rebuild the chain within 45 s if one relay is lost.

actions: compute relay positions on the GS-CMD-GS-OUTPOST line
assign one altitude per relay to reduce interference
fly to the slots at 160 m
replace a lost relay within 45 s
hand over or land at LZ-RIDGE

constraints: relay altitude >= 160 m - 20 m
no relay outside the geofence
failure_conditions: link down for more than 60 s in total
relay chain not established by t = 300 s
both relays hovering at the same slot

checkpoints.metric: time to first end-to-end link

checkpoints.name: Link continuity

Assemble the formation before the corridor entry; inside the corridor there are obstacle edges within 120 m. Keep formation error small, never trigger a separation warning, and complete the transit within 480 s. The corridor must be flown in complete radio silence: no transmissions between entry and exit.

build the V formation with 30 m spacing

constraints: constant speed inside the corridor

failure_conditions: formation broken for more than 30 s

Do not leave the geofence while chasing.

hand the track to the nearest UAV

constraints: minimum altitude 100 m - 20 m
no pursuit outside 400 m
failure_conditions: perimeter left uncovered for more than 120 s

tasks.brief: You are surveying BLOCK-EAST to 85 % at 90 m. At about t = 360 s the wind shifts by 70 deg and gusts to 15 m/s. Continuing on the old track heading will leave gaps, so re-plan the tracks and redistribute the strips. Coverage accuracy still matters more than finishing early.

tasks.title: Grid sampling of GRID-FUEL (9 points, revisit every 10 min)
tasks.brief: Sample the 9 points of the GRID-FUEL grid with the thermal sensor. Every point needs at least 3 samples, taken 10 +/- 2 min apart, and each sample must be geotagged within 5 m. Plan the order so that the revisit interval is respected without waiting on the ground.
tasks.objective: Collect at least 3 sensor samples at each of 9 grid points inside GRID-FUEL with a revisit interval of 10 +/- 2 min, and keep every sample geotagged within 5 m.

actions: order the 9 points into a route that meets the 10 min revisit
hold >= 3 s and take the thermal sample
return to each point 10 min after the first sample

constraints: hover >= 3 s at every point
no sampling above 30 m AGL
failure_conditions: fewer than half of the points visited

checkpoints.name: Sample completeness
checkpoints.metric: samples collected per grid point

checkpoints.name: Revisit timing
checkpoints.metric: interval between samples at the same point

checkpoints.name: Geotag accuracy
checkpoints.metric: sample position error

checkpoints.name: Data integrity
checkpoints.metric: uploaded samples and checksum status

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.metric: all UAVs landed at LZ-RIDGE
checkpoints.target: all on ground, no hard landing

tasks.title: Inspection of POI-FIRE-FRONT and POI-COMMS-MAST under EMCON
tasks.brief: Inspect POI-FIRE-FRONT and then POI-COMMS-MAST in a single sortie. From t = 240 s to t = 900 s the team must fly in complete radio silence: no telemetry, no messages, no updates. Agree on the timeline before takeoff, because during EMCON nobody can re-plan. After EMCON the team has 120 s to upload all images and confirm the completed angles.
tasks.objective: Inspect POI-FIRE-FRONT and POI-COMMS-MAST in one sortie with no radio transmission between 240 s and 900 s, then upload all images when the link is allowed again.

actions: agree on the timeboxed route before takeoff
capture 4 images per angle at POI-FIRE-FRONT then POI-COMMS-MAST

constraints: EMCON is absolute: no ping, no heartbeat, no re-plan
single sortie
failure_conditions: any transmission inside the EMCON window
an inspection angle missed with no time to recover

checkpoints.name: Radio silence
checkpoints.metric: transmissions during the EMCON window

checkpoints.name: Inspection completeness
checkpoints.metric: angles and images captured at POI-FIRE-FRONT and POI-COMMS-MAST
checkpoints.target: >= 4 images for >= 3 angles at both points

checkpoints.name: Standoff
checkpoints.metric: distance during capture

checkpoints.name: Upload window
checkpoints.metric: time from EMCON end to complete upload

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.metric: all UAVs landed
checkpoints.target: all on ground at the nearest landing zone
